name: Bandages of Peaceful Rest
body:
Aura moderate necromancy; CL 7th; Slot body; Price 1,400 gp; Weight 1 lb.

DESCRIPTION

These magical bandages were created to ensure loved ones a permanent transition into the afterlife.

EFFECTS

A corpse wrapped in a set of bandages of peaceful rest before burial is protected as if by a rest eternal spell.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells rest eternal; Cost 700 gp
